name: glossy_dark
title: 釉亮(试)
what: A test rig for glossy ware (S3, the coordinator's A/B on the 青花 dish): small bright sources and long thin strips placed where the glaze mirrors them, against black flock, so their reflections stand clear of the white under the glaze. Our choice [A], not a validated rig.

spectrum.why: as optics/rigs: one spectrum for all lamps (rgbscene's key)

lamps.name: key
lamps.why: small (0.014 sr): its mirror image, R x L ~ 0.045 x 1500/0.014, is several times the white under the glaze; front-left and high, where the far inner wall mirrors (a wall sloping ~40 deg seen from 35 deg up mirrors ~65 deg up in front)

lamps.name: top
lamps.why: a long thin strip overhead, a little in front, across the view: its image runs along the far inner wall

lamps.name: back
lamps.why: a strip low behind: the flat well and the far lip mirror ~35 deg up behind, the lip's round over a range

backdrop.why: dark surroundings: the glaze mirrors black where there is no lamp
